visualCharacteristics.structure: heading + text + list | heading + link list

contentPattern.structure: 1 row, 2 cells: intro (h2, paragraphs, optional list; content after the first paragraph collapses behind a Show more toggle) | quick links panel (title + list of anchor links). Desktop: intro ~2/3 beside a boxed ~1/3 panel with header row, divided link rows and arrow icons; stacked on mobile. The Featured option replaces the intro text with a featured story: optional leading h2 section title, then picture + heading (h3, may link) + text + CTA link, rendered as a pale-blue image-left card (image on top on mobile); no Show more collapse.
